note: Service-page imagery, loaded directly from the Unsplash CDN rather than committed to the repo. Every URL below was checked for a 200 and looked at, so the subject matches the caption — do not add an entry you have not opened. Sizing is baked into the query string (auto=format serves WebP/AVIF where supported); if a slot changes size, change w/h here, not in the template. Unsplash License: free for commercial use, no attribution required. `credit` is courtesy and is what you search to find the photo again. TRADEOFF: these render from an external host, so a removed photo becomes a broken slot with no build-time warning. To move to local files, download each url, drop it in src/assets/images/services/<page>/, and rewrite `url` to the local path — nothing else changes.
